reviews.text:
I contracted a fence with Lowe's to avoid contractor problems and they contracted the job to Triple C Builders.  I paid Lowe's the first week of August and it is August 24th.  My driveway is blocked with the lumber materials Lowe's delivery dropped off.  No fence started (an employee named Michelle said forecast said rain so they could not start).  Two days of sun and this company keeps giving excuses.
Please, avoid this company.  I have called them repeatedly, called Lowe's in Mesquite, and still no fence.  Unless Lowe's uses another contractor, avoid Triple C Builders.  I am highly disappointed in their customer service.  If they tell you this review is from a disgruntled client:  I am disgruntled and legitimately so!
reviews.author: Yolonda Stillwell-Williams

reviews.text: Triple C Builders removed old wood back patio deck and installed new concrete deck. My experience with the contractor was awesome!  They were very professional. I would recommend this company to anyone.
reviews.author: Patricia Turner

reviews.text:
CCC installed 260 ft of 6in gutter, they did a great job. The gutters seem well  made and the color is great, they cleaned up and left nothing behind.
Also finished in 1 day. Thank you!
reviews.author: Lisa Cade

reviews.text: Reliable and fast.  Always polite and friendly with foreman taking back unused materials and bringing back receipts.  Called back after a week to answer any concerns. Very pleased.

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed and outdated picture. The single, detailed negative review from 8 years ago is highly credible and describes severe service failures. The positive reviews are old and lack recent verification, with two being empty 5-star ratings. The stark Angi rating discrepancy and lack of recent feedback are concerning. The story suggests a contractor who may have provided good service historically but has no recent track record, and a past serious failure is documented.
fake_signals: Two 5-star Google reviews with empty text content
All positive Google reviews are 4-8 years old, negative review is 8 years old
Very low review volume (6) for an established company
No recent reviews to indicate current operational status
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed complaint with dates, names (Michelle), and material issues
Positive reviews mention specific project types (concrete deck, gutters) and crew behavior
BBB A+ rating suggests no recent formal complaints
complaint_patterns: Extreme delays and lack of communication
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google (4.3) and Angi (1.0). Google reviews are old (4-8 years) and include empty text reviews, while the single Angi review is recent and negative, suggesting a potential decline in service quality or operational issues.
